sanjay_oncall: Handoff from late swing — quick summary: saw a regen latency spike around 00:45 UTC affecting /v1/generate (eu-west1). KV cache hit-rate dropped to ~42% which increased backend token compute. We rolled a temporary routing rule to fallback to small-quant-1 which brought p95 down from ~1.8s to ~0.9s. No customer-facing 5xx. Mitigations: increased kvproxy pool by +20, disabled the prefetch experiment. Open actions below.

maya_sre: Thanks — can you drop the runbook link and a short timeline? Wondering if this is related to yesterday's LRU eviction tweak.

sanjay_oncall: Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-eviction. Timeline: 00:42 alert fired, 00:44 autoscaler added capacity, 00:46 routing fallback applied, 00:50 metrics stabilized. Prefetch toggle was the most likely culprit (correlates with spike).

liz_eng: I opened a revert PR for the prefetch change: PR #4203 https://git.internal/pr/4203 — would appreciate a quick review so we can roll the change back cleanly.

alex_dev: On it, will review in ~20m. Also spotted repeated errors in logs: `kvproxy: connection reset by peer` — increasing pool helps short-term but we should add health checks and backoff on that path.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled 2026-03-18T01:15Z — feature/prefetch-toggle -> staging (sha: abc123).

maya_sre: Blocker note: a small subset of customers saw elevated latency for long-context prompts (~2.5s p95). Recommend keeping fallback route active for the next 2h and consider a temporary token-limit to reduce regen storms.

sanjay_oncall: Agreed. Next steps: 1) Liz to merge PR #4203 revert and watch canary. 2) Alex to open PR for kvproxy basic health-check + retry/backoff. 3) Ops keep fallback route +20 pool for 2h and monitor dashboards. I’ll update the incident doc with timestamps and links.

liz_eng: Merging now and will watch canary. :thumbsup:

alex_dev: I’ll open the draft PR for the kvproxy health check in ~30m and paste link here.

sanjay_oncall: If it escalates, page me. Otherwise handing monitoring to @maya_sre for the next window. Leaving post-incident TODOs in the doc. Good night folks.

maya_sre: Taking over monitoring. I’ll post an update in ~1h or sooner if we see variance. 👍
